untraded_deaths.coach: {events} deaths without a trade. Play close enough to a teammate for them to trade you.

isolated_deaths.coach: {events} deaths with no teammate in trade range. Don't take fights alone.
isolated_deaths.analyst: {events} isolated deaths: {session} of your deaths, against {reference}.

missed_trades.coach: {events} times a teammate died near you and you didn't trade. Be ready to swing right after the contact.

opening_deaths.coach: You lost {events} opening duels. Take the first fight with information or utility, or let it come to you.

openings_lost.coach: {events} rounds lost after your opening kill. Play the advantage: regroup and trade, don't hunt.
openings_lost.analyst: {events} rounds lost after an opening kill: conversion {session}, against {reference}.

clutches_lost.coach: {events} clutches lost. Use the clock and take the duels one at a time.

duels_without_damage.coach: {events} times you died without touching your killer. Work on crosshair placement and the first bullet.
duels_without_damage.analyst: {events} duels lost without damage; HS % {session}, against {reference}.

wasted_utility.coach: You died {events} times with grenades still on you. Throw them before taking the fight.
wasted_utility.analyst: {events} deaths with unused grenades: {session} per death, against {reference}.

team_flashes.coach: Your flashes blinded teammates {events} times. Call them, and throw them past your teammates.

recurring_death_spot.coach: You keep dying untraded at {zone} on {map} ({side}): {events} times this session. Change the position or the timing.
recurring_death_spot.analyst: {zone}, {map} ({side}): {events} untraded deaths this session, {history} over the period.
